Hi Olivia — thanks for the quick heads-up and the SOW. Good problem to have (congrats on the adoption).

Short answers up front:
- We can support an incremental 120k tokens/month starting Dec 1.
- For co-terming to 2027-04-01 we typically offer a blended pro-rate approach and can apply a one-time credit for unused committed units on a monthly pro-rata basis.

I'll pull the exact pricing numbers and a draft amendment for your legal team. Would you prefer the uplift priced at the existing tier rate or at a flat uplift rate for the added capacity? If you want, we can propose two options (conservative and aggressive) for your procurement to choose from.

I'll loop in Ben (AE) and Jordan (Sales Ops) to finalize numbers. Expect a formal amendment draft and pricing table by EOD Wednesday.

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Blueframe uplift — pricing options and recommended path (internal)

Ben/Jordan — Blueframe wants +120k tokens/mo starting Dec 1 and to co-term on 2027-04-01. Attached is their SOW. Customer expectations: minimal friction, legal wants clear pro-rate math, procurement will push on discount.

Suggested approach (keep it simple):
1) Option A (standard): Apply existing tier pricing to incremental units; pro-rate Dec–Mar by days and apply any unused commitment credit toward the new co-term structure. No additional discount.
2) Option B (partnership): 10% uplift discount on incremental units for 12 months if they commit to the new co-term (effective Apr 1). Offer a one-time implementation credit of $2,500 for migration assistance.

Metrics to check: current blended unit price, their realized monthly token consumption, and legal's preferred amendment template. We can use a blended rate to keep invoice simple (single line item for additional committed units).

Please confirm which option we present to the customer. If Ben prefers, we can also offer a small performance SLA credit (1 day response) to sweeten the ask.

Thanks — Eve
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Blueframe uplift — pricing options and recommended path (internal)

Eve — I like Option B for commercial momentum. A 10% uplift discount + $2.5k implementation credit should close quickly and keeps ARR growth visible. A couple of guardrails:
- Limit the discount to the incremental 120k tokens (not retroactive).
- Add an early-termination protection clause that preserves the discount if they stay through the new co-term date.

Jordan — can you draft the amendment with the blended-rate line item and add the pro-rate calc (days-based) + a single credit line? If legal needs a second, I'll flag to CS for the small SLA carveout.

Ben

- Option 1 (Conservative): Incremental units billed at current tier rates; pro-rate for Dec 1–Mar 31 by day and apply unused credit to the new co-term starting Apr 1. No additional discount.
- Option 2 (Partnership — recommended): 10% discount on the incremental 120k tokens for 12 months after Dec 1 + a $2,500 one-time implementation credit; discount applies only to the incremental units and is conditional on co-term alignment to Apr 1.
